data.content: {"stage":"review","round":2,"verdict":"fail","blocking_count":4,"warning_count":2,"findings":[{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-update-task","requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df"],"message":"US-update-task is not planned to include the FE edit form's trigger, but more importantly FE-task-edit-form-prefill and update tasks never deliver the 'Status Change' via the update path; however the clearest gap is that the status change story is in separate story, so this is fine. Real gap: the update story's AC1 says the task list shows the new title, but FE-task-update-result-messages DoD 4 only covers refresh; no task builds an entry point (edit action) on the task list to open the edit form.","suggested_fix":"Add an edit action on each task row in FE-task-edit-form-prefill that opens the form in edit mode."},{"check_id":"CRIT-OVERLAP","severity":"blocking","item_key":"FE-task-update-result-messages","requirement_ids":[],"message":"DoD 4 'task list refreshes to the new values after a successful save' duplicates FE-task-list-auto-refresh, which already reloads the list after update.","suggested_fix":"Remove DoD 4 and rely on FE-task-list-auto-refresh."},{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-delete-task","requirement_ids":["R-8523b9ec"],"message":"QA-delete-task-test-suite lists no requirements, and no delete task covers the GET /tasks/{id} AC8 in tests; also US-delete-task owns GET /tasks/{id} although the story is about deletion, while the edit story needs it.","suggested_fix":"Move BE-get-task-by-id-endpoint to the update story (or the view story) and move AC8 there; set QA requirements on the delete test suite."},{"check_id":"CRIT-CONSTRAINT","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-export-report-excel","requirement_ids":["R-3a63e0ce"],"message":"FE-report-excel-download-action and BE-task-report-excel-generator assume backend generation before the decision task is made, and the generator says it would be replaced if the decision is frontend. FE-report-export-no-data-message has no dependency on the generator or action and BE generator DoD 4 returns an error for no data, duplicating the FE no-data handling.","suggested_fix":"Keep the no-data check in one place: remove BE generator DoD 4 or make the FE message task react to that response, and add a dependency."},{"check_id":"CRIT-PRD-GAP","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-create-task","requirement_ids":[],"message":"Edge case 2 and its wording is confusing; the PRD does not say whether the Due Date is mandatory or who sets the Creation Date default.","suggested_fix":"List as open question.","open_question":"The PRD does not state whether a task can be saved without a Due Date."},{"check_id":"CRIT-PRD-GAP","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-view-task-report","requirement_ids":[],"message":"The PRD does not say whether the report metrics change when filters are applied.","suggested_fix":"Add as open question.","open_question":"The PRD does not state whether the Total, Open and Completed metrics reflect the applied filters or all stored tasks."}],"resolved":["F-fa675d","F-cb7d7a","F-acfbeb","F-8555a6","F-000d1d","F-326b5a"],"still_open":[]}
